subject: general
question:
**Direction: Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error’**

An appeasement policies / was all but a sham to misdirect / the local groups.

options.text: was all but a sham to misdirect

solution:
Here, the erroneous part is **"An appeasement policies."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The error in the given sentence lies in subject-verb agreement.
 
• The subject is "An appeasement policies."
 
• However, "policies" is plural, whereas "An appeasement" is singular.
 
• According to the subject-verb agreement rule, a singular subject requires a singular verb, and a plural subject requires a plural verb.
 
• To correct the error and maintain subject-verb agreement, "policies" should be changed to its singular form, which is "policy.

 

The correct answer is Option 3.

 

Correct sentence: ***An appeasement policy**__ was all but a sham to misdirect the local groups.*
